five_minutes: The Federal Reserve's economic projections will clarify the US rate path, directly influencing Treasury yields and foreign capital flows into Indian markets.
RBI absorbed ₹2.4 lakh crore via VRRR auctions, sharply scaling up liquidity mop-up operations to keep overnight rates aligned with the policy repo rate.
The RBI announced a ₹30,000 crore sovereign debt switch auction to smooth government maturity profiles without adding benchmark supply pressure.
Trump's threats of retaliatory trade measures against the EU heighten international trade fragmentation risks and currency volatility.
ECB wage projections pointing to 2.7% growth through early 2027 signal persistent services cost pressure, limiting aggressive European rate cuts.

buckets.label: What you need to know today

items.headline: Fed economic projections set rate cut trajectory and dictate global capital flow dynamics
items.what_happened: The Federal Reserve Board and FOMC released economic projections from the September 15-16 meeting.
items.why_it_matters: The SEP dot plot and macro forecasts clarify the US rate path, directly influencing Treasury yields, USD strength, and foreign portfolio flows into Indian equities and debt.
items.action: Revisit US rate cut pricing and portfolio duration assumptions following dot plot release.

items.headline: ECB wage growth projections signal persistent cost pressures, limiting European rate cut potential
items.what_happened: The ECB wage tracker pointed to a 2.7% negotiated wage growth rate in H1 2027, indicating a modest uptick.
items.why_it_matters: Firm negotiated wage trends keep European disinflation slow, maintaining floor support for ECB policy rates and European bond yields.

items.headline: Bank of England rate pause expected as persistent inflation limits room for monetary easing
items.what_happened: Analyst forecasts indicate the Bank of England will hold interest rates steady, facing tough choices amid lingering inflation pressures.
items.why_it_matters: A prolonged rate hold maintains upward pressure on UK gilt yields and sterling, widening yield differentials against central banks that are actively cutting rates.

items.headline: Trump tariff threats against EU escalate global trade policy uncertainty and currency volatility
items.what_happened: Following plans for Canada to become an associate member of the EU, Donald Trump threatened to cut trade with the European Union.
items.why_it_matters: Escalating trade threats heighten global cross-border friction, creating downside risks for trade-reliant currencies and international equity sentiment.

items.headline: Rising fuel costs kept UK inflation elevated, reinforcing Bank of England hawkish stance
items.what_happened: Rebounding petrol and diesel prices along with summer holiday travel costs pushed UK inflation higher.
items.why_it_matters: Energy-driven headline inflation prevents the Bank of England from initiating early policy easing, keeping UK sovereign borrowing costs elevated.

items.headline: SEC proposal to end Rule 14a-8 curbs activist shareholder mandates on US corporate boards
items.what_happened: The SEC proposed rescinding Rule 14a-8 under the Securities Exchange Act, citing that it exceeds statutory authority and intrudes into state corporate law.
items.why_it_matters: Rescinding the rule reduces corporate compliance burdens for US equities and curtails activist proxy proposals, shifting board oversight back to state legal frameworks.

items.headline: RBI expanded liquidity absorption to ₹2.4 lakh crore, tightening overnight money market rates
items.what_happened: RBI accepted ₹2,39,959 crore out of ₹3,00,000 crore notified in its 1-day VRRR auction at a weighted average rate of 5.24%.
items.why_it_matters: Following earlier modest absorption of ₹40,302 crore, this substantial drain of surplus liquidity anchors money market rates closer to the policy repo rate and supports short-term yield stability.

items.headline: RBI's ₹30,000 crore debt switch mitigates near-term government redemption risk without adding yield pressure
items.what_happened: The RBI announced an auction to convert/switch Government of India source securities worth ₹30,000 crore into longer-dated destination securities.
items.why_it_matters: Exchanging near-term debt maturities for longer tenors smoothes the fiscal redemption schedule and prevents market supply shocks across the G-sec yield curve.

items.headline: Upcoming ₹28,000 crore debt auction will test primary dealer demand and benchmark 10Y yield stability
items.what_happened: Government of India announced the re-issue auction of government securities for ₹28,000 crore on September 18, 2026, with primary dealer underwriting commitments.
items.why_it_matters: Auction bidding metrics and cut-off yields will indicate institutional appetite for government paper, directly driving near-term moves in the India 10Y G-sec yield.
items.action: Monitor auction cut-off yields on Friday to gauge institutional supply absorption capacity.

items.headline: Short-term sovereign yields stabilized as 364-day T-bill auction cut-off held steady at 6.04%
items.what_happened: RBI issued T-bills with cut-off yields of 5.2801% for 91-day, 5.7500% for 182-day, and 6.0386% for 364-day paper against strong demand across tenors.
items.why_it_matters: Yields held near previous levels, showing well-anchored money market pricing and steady demand for short-dated government paper.

items.headline: RBI announces Sovereign Gold Bond redemption price, offering exit liquidity at elevated gold valuations
items.what_happened: RBI set the premature redemption price for SGB 2019-20 Series IV due on September 17, 2026, following the completion of five years from issue.
items.why_it_matters: Provides benchmark valuation and liquidity for wealth management clients evaluating portfolio rebalancing out of gold holdings after substantial five-year gains.

items.headline: RBI Priority Sector Lending updates force commercial banks to realign portfolio allocation strategies
items.what_happened: RBI issued the Priority Sector Lending Third Amendment Directions, 2026, updating targets and classification rules for banks.
items.why_it_matters: Revisions to PSL targets alter bank credit compliance requirements, impacting sub-segment lending costs and activity in the PSLC secondary market.
items.action: Review bank client credit portfolios against revised PSL classification rules.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: RBI rationalization of FEMA circulars eases cross-border transaction compliance for banks
items.what_happened: RBI issued A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 21 reviewing and rationalizing extant circulars issued under the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999.
items.why_it_matters: Simplifying foreign exchange compliance frameworks reduces procedural hurdles and regulatory overhead for cross-border banking and foreign investments.
items.action: Audit regulatory compliance lists against newly rationalized FEMA circular provisions.
